claims.claim: Origen of Alexandria was a Christian theologian and head of the Catechetical School of Alexandria who lived circa 185–254 CE.
The work belongs to Origen’s extensive biblical commentary tradition on the Psalter, of which only fragments survive today.
Portions of Origen’s Psalms commentary are quoted in later catenae, preserving additional fragments of his exegesis.

The Psalms homilies constitute the largest surviving body of Origen’s own Old‑Testament exegesis, offering insight into early Christian theology, biblical interpretation, and the cultural context of the third‑century Mediterranean world.
Origen was ordained a priest by the bishops of Caesarea and Jerusalem, a step that later caused conflict with the Alexandrian bishop Demetrius.
